input_box_content.user_input_content:
=== CHARACTER LOCK — STRICT ===

RIVEN:

Use the provided Adult Riven reference image as the strict primary character reference.

Preserve Riven's exact facial identity, pale-blonde hair, hairstyle, body proportions, clothing and armor design, sword design, and overall silhouette.

Riven must remain unmistakably the same character throughout the entire video.

Keep her original costume, hairstyle, armor, body proportions, and sword unchanged.

Riven is now an experienced battlefield warrior.

She is fast, skilled, aggressive when necessary, and completely accustomed to fighting inside a large battle.

Her sword remains intact throughout the scene.


=== ACTIVE WAR — CRITICAL ===

THIS IS AN ACTIVE LARGE-SCALE BATTLE.

The battle is happening RIGHT NOW.

From the FIRST FRAME until the END of the scene, many soldiers from TWO opposing armies are actively fighting across the battlefield.

The battlefield must NEVER look abandoned, empty, quiet, or like the aftermath of a battle.

There must be continuous visible warfare around Riven.

Soldiers clash with swords and weapons throughout the foreground, middle ground, and background.

Groups of soldiers push against each other.

Individual soldiers fight at close range.

Other soldiers rush through the battlefield to reinforce ongoing fights.

The two armies should feel like they are colliding across a large battlefield.

Riven is only one warrior inside this much larger war.

Do not isolate Riven in an empty environment.

Do not clear the battlefield around her.

Do not show Riven wandering through ruins.

Do not portray the battle as already finished.


=== BATTLEFIELD ATMOSPHERE ===

Create the atmosphere of a violent medieval fantasy war in progress.

Smoke moves across parts of the battlefield.

Small and medium fires burn in several areas.

Wooden structures and battlefield objects are burning.

Flames flicker visibly through the smoke.

Dust and dirt are kicked into the air by soldiers running and fighting.

Weapons clash.

Soldiers move rapidly through the environment.

The distant battlefield remains filled with active combat.

The environment should feel hot, loud, crowded, dangerous, and alive.

Fire and smoke are atmospheric elements of the ACTIVE battle, not evidence that the battle has already ended.


=== ARMY CLARITY ===

There are TWO clearly distinguishable armies fighting each other.

Riven belongs to one army.

Her allied soldiers fight beside and around her.

Enemy soldiers wear visually different armor and equipment.

Riven attacks ONLY enemy soldiers.

Allies never attack Riven.

Riven never attacks allied soldiers.

Both armies must remain visibly present throughout the scene.


=== OPENING — IMMEDIATE COMBAT ===

START DIRECTLY WITH RIVEN ALREADY FIGHTING.

No establishing shot.

No walking.

No preparation.

No slow introduction.

No empty battlefield shot.

The first moment should immediately show Riven in close combat with enemy soldiers while the war rages around her.

Riven is already moving, blocking, striking, turning, and fighting through enemy soldiers.

At the same time, allied and enemy soldiers are visibly fighting all around her.

The audience should immediately understand:

RIVEN IS IN THE MIDDLE OF A LARGE ACTIVE WAR.


=== MAIN ACTION ===

Follow Riven through the ongoing battle.

She fights aggressively through enemy soldiers who engage her while the two armies continue fighting around her.

Make the combat fast, intense, physical, and cinematic.

Riven should move naturally from one immediate opponent to another as the battle shifts around her.

She can block attacks, counterattack, evade, reposition, use powerful sword strikes, and move quickly through close-range combat.

Do NOT choreograph every individual strike mechanically.

Allow the combat to flow naturally like a high-budget cinematic battle sequence.

Riven should constantly feel surrounded by an active war.

Sometimes soldiers rush past behind her.

Sometimes nearby groups collide.

Sometimes fire or smoke fills part of the frame.

Sometimes another fight briefly crosses close to Riven before moving away.

Keep the battlefield visually alive.

Riven remains the main camera focus, but the WAR must always remain visible around her.


=== RIVEN'S FIGHTING STYLE ===

Riven fights with confidence and experience.

Her swordsmanship is powerful and fast.

She can use short explosive bursts of movement and recognizable sweeping attacks inspired by her combat style.

Keep the movement physically grounded.

She should look impressive without appearing invincible.

Do not turn the scene into a magical superhero fight.

No teleportation.

No flying.

No giant energy attacks.

No glowing battlefield explosion.

Her skill with the sword is the focus.


=== CAMERA ===

Use energetic cinematic battlefield cinematography.

The camera stays close enough to Riven that her combat remains readable, but frequently allows enough depth and width to show the large battle continuing behind and around her.

Use dynamic tracking as Riven fights through the battlefield.

Occasionally reveal wider compositions showing dozens of soldiers from both armies actively fighting.

Do not frame Riven against empty backgrounds.

Do not repeatedly isolate her from other soldiers.

Maintain the feeling that the camera is following Riven THROUGH a real ongoing war.


=== ENDING ===

Do NOT end with the battlefield becoming empty.

Do NOT show Riven alone after defeating everyone.

Do NOT imply that the battle has ended.

Near the end, Riven defeats the enemies immediately engaging her.

She gets only a brief moment to recover.

Around her, the war continues at full intensity.

Riven immediately turns toward another part of the battlefield where fighting is still raging.

She grips her sword and moves back toward the ongoing combat.

CUT while the larger battle is STILL ACTIVE.


=== TECHNICAL ===

High-end live-action cinematic realistic dark fantasy.

16:9 cinematic widescreen.

Feature-film large-scale battle quality.

Realistic human anatomy.

Natural human movement.

Realistic sword combat.

Realistic armor and weapon physics.

Realistic fire, smoke, dust, cloth, and hair physics.

Maintain strict Riven identity consistency.

Maintain one consistent sword.

Keep combat readable despite the scale of the battle.

No dialogue.

No narration.

No subtitles.

No captions.

No visible text.

No watermark.

No logo.


=== CORE VISUAL IDEA ===

This must look like Riven fighting INSIDE A WAR.

Not Riven fighting alone on a ruined battlefield.

Not the aftermath of a battle.

Not an empty burning field.

The visual priority is:

TWO ARMIES ACTIVELY FIGHTING
+
FIRE AND SMOKE THROUGHOUT THE BATTLEFIELD
+
CONSTANT SOLDIER MOVEMENT
+
RIVEN ALREADY CUTTING THROUGH ENEMY SOLDIERS FROM THE OPENING MOMENT.

The scene begins in combat.

The scene stays in combat.

The scene ends while the war is still raging.
